recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce help into questionnaire-display-category in core; any future clarification should be made in the Extension Pack and account for FHIR-24117.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core Questionnaire change request asking for item-specific help associated with Questionnaire items by adding a help code to questionnaire-display-category.
initial_application: Core commit dccbce4bf6/GF#17208, matching Jira's svn revision 14070 comment, added the help concept and approved definition to source/questionnaire/codesystem-questionnaire-display-category.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-24117 later resolved the overlap between questionnaire-display-category help and questionnaire-item-control help by removing help from display-category. Commit 17fa4f6e5e applied that reversal, dd468d4f17 later removed the Questionnaire extension terminology artifacts from core, and the current Extension Pack display-category CodeSystem omits help while item-control retains help.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was made because restoring display-category help would contradict the later FHIR-24117 decision and the current authoritative terminology source is already consistent.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive decision removed the help code that FHIR-17208 originally added because itemControl already provided the help-button mechanism.
